scientific_limitations: Strict, time-labelled optimum burning schedules on labeled ordinary cycles of order k^2-2 for k>=3; only source slides along a cycle edge. title: Two-defect mobility and degree census of optimal burning schedules on \(C_{k^2-2}\)
